data.rationale: The proposal captures the right overall procedure and order (Wikipedia, then Booking, then a note), but it omits the review-score ≥ 8 filter and the "do not reserve" constraint, says "first hotel" instead, and adds an unstated one-night assumption. It also does not name the Booking and Notes tab switches or the "New note" click, and it merges check-in and check-out into vague "date" parameters, so an automation could not be built from it directly.
